title: Integrate RESIDUAL with CI/CD
summary: Adopt RESIDUAL's evidence and qualification gates in CI/CD without turning CI into an alternate authority path.

steps.title: Map existing qualification gates
steps.detail: Identify which RESIDUAL checks are authoritative and which outputs are advisory.

steps.title: Pin the release head
steps.detail: Run qualification on the exact commit that will be promoted; do not reuse stale approval/evidence.

steps.title: Preserve evidence
steps.detail: Retain run IDs, hashes, and generated evidence artifacts with the release candidate.
